name: International Christian University
summary: Liberal-arts university in Mitaka, Tokyo, founded in 1953: one bachelor's with 31 majors, entered through English and studied bilingually.

ib.text: IB Full Diploma only (no course certificates or IBCP); predicted grades are accepted, with final results due as soon as released. IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 79 minimum. Assessed on documents, no interview for IB applicants.

dates.label: Second application period closes, 23:59 JST (last period)

programmes.name: Liberal Arts
programmes.about: One bachelor's in liberal arts with 31 majors across humanities, social sciences and natural sciences; you declare a major before third year. You enter through English but must also complete the Japanese Language Program to graduate.
programmes.ib: Bilingual degree: you cannot graduate studying only in English; the Japanese Language Program is a graduation requirement.
programmes.selectionNote: Transcripts, essay and recommendation letters weigh equally. About 100 places on the English route; September 2026 admitted 234 of 683 first-year applicants.
programmes.closesNote: Last of two September periods; the first closes sooner.

notes: The first and second application periods carry no advantage or disadvantage; you may apply in only one, and a rejected applicant must wait a year to reapply.
ICU's fee page lists the Matriculation Fee as ¥300,000 once; tuition and facilities fees are paid per term, not as a year in advance.
Spring (April) entry also exists, but an IB student finishing in May 2027 enters in September 2027.
